admin.m3.t002: Each of the 252 species decides by habit: depth layer, time of day, season, weather, bottom type and lure action all matter.
admin.m3.t006: "Weight" sets how often this species appears: higher is more common, and the percentage on the right is the converted share. Off or a weight of 0 means this water does not spawn it.
admin.m3.t007: "Bait-driven pacing" is off (the switch is under "Gameplay rules → Other"): once on, good/poor bait and lure wait windows appear here; while off these values take no part in any calculation.
admin.m3.t008: Switch every skill at once: vanilla chance, all 100%, or per-skill custom. 0 = vanilla formula, 100 = always increases.
admin.m3.t014: While a member fishes online: +50% experience, +10% bite rate, +25% skill-up chance, with no daily time limit.
admin.m3.t020: Multiplier that nudges the mid-tier wait distribution inside its window; 1.6 slows the sample by 60%. Usually leave it and just edit the wait window above.

admin.m3.t023: A match score at or above this counts as mid-tier bait; below it is poor bait. Bait with no evidence scores 0.30 (poor, but not zeroed).
admin.m3.t027: When on, bite pace depends on bait and action: bottom/float depends on bait match; lures and sea jigging also on the retrieve action. With both matched a fish arrives within 1.5–6 s; a mismatched action waits long, like poor bait. It only paces bites, never changes what spawns.
admin.m3.t028: When on, sea rigs correct the depth layer through the sea state machine: sinking follows relative progress and bottom sits at 0.93. When off, the old lure real-time depth / fixed bottom applies.
admin.m3.t029: Forgot the password? The account and password are in config.yaml in the server folder (admin.username / admin.password). The release package defaults to admin / admin123.
admin.m3.t030: Minimum interval between line-snap rolls while fighting. The official "sprint" is a local client move; the server approximates it at this pace.
admin.m3.t031: Logs come from the audit table
admin.m3.t035: Defaults apply without a whole-item override. Saving any field writes silver price, gold price and stock together; clearing a filled field takes the current base value and will not follow later base changes. To inherit again, restore the whole item.
admin.m3.t036: The further float fishing strays from the band, the lower the species weight. At 30% of the fishing depth it drops to this multiplier; skipped when depth is unknown. Other methods use this multiplier beyond a 15% tolerance.
admin.m3.t037: Freshwater moves through four stages — routine → gathering → swim fed → monsters — spawning better fish as it goes; sea fishing and lures follow the same stages.
admin.m3.t039: Predators such as pike, taimen, gar and porbeagle can bite through the leader during a fight. When off, only ordinary tension overload breaks the line.
admin.m3.t040: Exclusive: only listed fish can be caught inside. Boost: listed fish are more common inside. Zones apply about 30 seconds after saving, regardless of other gameplay switches.
admin.m3.t041: Player profiles involve account data, so the backend withholds them when signed out. This page loads automatically after signing in; other pages stay viewable without it.
admin.m3.t042: Gameplay feel, hook-type bites, electric reels and wear, load and character state. Takes effect within 30 seconds; no service restart.
admin.m3.t043: Used to fill in the codex. A backfill counts as a catch but grants no experience or currency and is not added to the keepnet. Real catches are never overwritten. The save is backed up automatically before writing. Prefer backfilling while the player is offline.
admin.m3.t044: Always mode grants skill on every qualifying catch, dig or craft; fixed-percentage mode does not stack happy-hour corrections on the vanilla chance.
admin.m3.t045: 's backfill weight must be a positive whole number of grams; leave empty to derive it automatically.
admin.m3.t046: Clears this water's bite settings and manual species weights right away, and discards this page's draft. Restores the weekly baseline when one exists, otherwise the static weights.
admin.m3.t048: Wait this long and a bite is guaranteed (lures excepted). With "Bait-driven pacing" on this item is ignored: bottom/float upper waits come from the good/poor bait windows below, and sea fishing from "Sea wait bounds" under Advanced.
admin.m3.t052: The account and password are in config.yaml in the server folder (admin.username / admin.password). The release package defaults to admin / admin123.
admin.m3.t053: Longest wait for lure fishing. With "Bait-driven pacing" on it only binds the good tier (bait and action both matched); mid/poor tiers come from the lure mid/poor wait bounds below.
admin.m3.t057: The rarer the catch, the more skill per gain. The multiplier only scales the increment, not the "does it grow this time" chance above, and applies in both modes. Base increments are 0.1 or 0.2, rounded to 0.1 after multiplying — whole multiples such as 1/2/4/8 are safer, so 0.15 is not rounded up to 0.2. 0 stops that tier entirely. Crafting and digging have no grade, so they always use 1×.
admin.m3.t060: A preset covers six rules: bait must match, species habits, weather & water temperature, shoal distribution, sea depth-layer influence and fish picking bait. Happy hour is separate.
admin.m3.t061: Lower wait bound in seconds for the lure reel when bait and action match. The 1.5 default matches the vanilla short retrieve window; raising it can make fish arrive after you reel in, so leave it alone.
admin.m3.t062: Lower wait bound in seconds for the lure reel with average bait or action; by default the same window as mid-tier bottom bait. A better action immediately requeues into the good short window.
admin.m3.t063: Below this lure tendency a fish does not attack lures (loach about 0.2, pike about 2). Requires "Bait must match".
